# CORE-STR-05

**Does every element and connector reference resolve?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | STR: Structure |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |

## Rule

Every local id used as a reference is the id of an element, connector, trust zone, data set or scenario in the specification; ids are unique.
